name: Floor rail, galvanised steel channel
function: Carries one side of the machine. The wheels run in its channel.

name: Rail anchor plate 260 x 160 x 12
function: Spreads the rail load into the slab. Grouted under.

name: Concrete screw anchor M12 x 100
function: Holds the anchor plate in the slab. No mortar: it cuts its own thread.

name: Trolley weldment
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Carries one leg on 2 wheels and the travel drive.

name: Side guide roller 60 mm
function: Keeps the wheel centred in its rail.

name: Travel gearmotor 0.75 kW, helical-bevel, brake, encoder
function: Drives one wheel. The brake holds the machine still while it sprays.

name: Travel wheel 200 x 60, polyurethane on steel hub
function: Rolls in the rail channel. Quiet on wet steel.

name: Deep groove ball bearing 6210-2RS
function: Carries the wheel on its axle.

name: Hex head screw M10 x 35
function: Holds the travel gearmotor flange to the trolley.

name: Hex head screw M12 x 50
function: Holds the wheel axle block to the trolley.

name: Beam top cover, aluminium 2 mm
function: Keeps spray off the valves and blowers on the beam.

name: Portal beam weldment
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Spans the bay: 2 chords and 4 cross members. Every tool hangs at its own station along it, so none can meet another.

name: Leg cladding panel, aluminium 2 mm
function: Covers the leg frame. It keeps spray out of the frame.

name: Portal leg weldment
material: Structural steel S355, painted safety yellow
function: Carries the beam over the trolley: 2 posts and 2 braces. Its flanges bolt top and bottom.

name: Hex head screw M16 x 60
function: Bolts the leg flange to the trolley or the beam.

name: Button head screw M5 x 12
function: Holds the beam cover to the chord.

name: Button head screw M6 x 16
function: Holds the cladding panel to the leg frame.

name: Flat-fan spray nozzle 1/4 in, 15 deg
function: Makes a 15 degree flat fan. Its tip is the only part that wears.

name: Spray arch manifold, 124 mm
function: Carries the foam and the rinse water to the nozzles. Stainless: wash chemicals do not touch carbon steel.

name: Solenoid valve G 1/2, 24 V DC, stainless
function: Switches one chemical or the rinse water to the arch.

name: Socket head cap screw M6 x 20
subsystems: Spray arch x8; Top brush (overhead) x8
function: Holds the rail block to the hanger.

name: Pipe clamp M10, stainless
function: Holds the arch pipe to its bracket.

name: Top brush hanger
function: Hangs the brush from its lift carriage.

name: Profile rail block size 25
subsystems: Top brush (overhead) x2; Side brushes x4
function: Recirculating ball carriage. It runs on the rail and carries the moving stage.

name: Profile rail size 25 x 1600
function: Hardened guide rail. It carries the block in a straight line with no play.

name: Top brush gearmotor 0.75 kW, 135 rpm
function: Turns the top brush. Its current tells the lift how hard the brush presses.

name: Top brush lift gearmotor 0.37 kW, brake
function: Raises and lowers the top brush. Its brake holds it when power is off.

name: Top brush shaft, stainless
function: Carries the brush between its 2 bearings.

name: Flanged bearing unit, 4-bolt, stainless, 60 mm
subsystems: Top brush (overhead) x2; Side brushes x2
function: Carries one end of a brush shaft.

name: Top brush, closed-cell foam strips
function: Scrubs the car top. Foam strips do not hold grit, so they do not scratch the paint.

name: Hex head screw M10 x 30
subsystems: Control, supply and signals x4; Top brush (overhead) x4; Side brushes x8
function: Holds the top brush gearmotor to its hanger.

name: Hex head screw M12 x 40
subsystems: Top brush (overhead) x8; Side brushes x8
function: Holds the bearing unit to the hanger.

name: Hex head screw M8 x 25
function: Holds the lift gearmotor to the beam.

name: Socket head cap screw M6 x 25
function: Holds the lift rail to the beam face.

name: Side brush carriage
function: Runs on 2 rails under the beam and carries the brush, its motor and bearings.

name: Profile rail size 25 x 1800
function: Hardened guide rail. It carries the block in a straight line with no play.

name: Side brush gearmotor 1.1 kW, 113 rpm
function: Turns one side brush. Its current tells the carriage how hard it presses.

name: Gear rack module 2, 20 x 20, stainless
function: The carriage pinion runs along it.

name: Side brush shaft, stainless
function: Hangs the brush from its carriage.

name: Side brush, closed-cell foam strips
function: Scrubs one flank, its doors and wheels.

name: Side brush, closed-cell foam strips
function: Scrubs one flank, its doors and wheels.

name: Socket head cap screw M6 x 16
subsystems: Control, supply and signals x4; Side brushes x16
function: Holds the rail block to the carriage.

name: Socket head cap screw M6 x 30
function: Holds the side brush rail to the beam.

name: Air knife bracket, stainless
function: Hangs an air knife from its slide.

name: Centrifugal blower 4 kW, wash-down
function: Makes the drying air. The air leaves the knives at high speed.

name: Flexible duct, 380 x 160
function: Feeds the top knife from its blower. It folds as the knife lifts.

name: Side air knife, stainless
function: Blows the water off one flank.

name: Top air knife, stainless
function: Blows a sheet of air down over the car top. It follows the shape.

name: Hex head screw M10 x 30
function: Holds the blower foot to the beam cover frame.

name: Socket head cap screw M8 x 20
function: Holds the bracket to the air knife.

name: Wand reach tube, 52 mm
function: Reaches in through the door opening to the cabin floor. It is the vacuum duct.

name: Wand column stage 1 (sleeve), 110 x 110
function: Fixed through the beam. It guides the next stage.

name: Wand column stage 2, 94 x 94
function: Slides a third of the drop. A belt over its pulley drives the next stage.

name: Wand column stage 3, 80 x 80
function: Slides a third of the drop. A belt over its pulley drives the next stage.

name: Wand column stage 4, 66 x 66
function: Carries the reach slide at its foot.

name: Wand drop servo gearmotor 0.4 kW, brake
function: Drives stage 2 by a toothed belt. Its brake holds the column with power off.

name: Wand vacuum head with lamp
function: Vacuums the floor and lights it for the camera.

name: Socket head cap screw M8 x 25
function: Clamps the wand mast under the beam.

name: Cable carrier link 120 x 50
function: Guides the cables and hoses through the moving joint. It keeps the bend radius safe.

name: Status beacon
function: Teal at home, green working, amber moving.

name: Control cabinet, stainless, IP66
function: Holds the controller, 8 drives, the safety relay and the valve outputs. It talks to the twin over the site network.

name: Signal lamp, green, 100 mm
function: Green: the machine is home. The car may go.

name: Signal lamp, red, 100 mm
function: Red: the program runs. The car must not move.

name: Stop light housing
function: Faces the arriving car. It tells the car and its driver to stop or go.
